cd "$(pwd)" && cat > .tmp_load.py << 'EOF'
import os, google.cloud.bigquery as bq
project=os.environ["GCP_PROJECT"]; ds=os.environ["GCP_BQ_DATASET"]
client=bq.Client(project=project)
table_id=f"{project}.{ds}.training_data"
schema=[bq.SchemaField("row_id","STRING")]+[bq.SchemaField(f"f{i}","FLOAT64") for i in range(1,7)]+[bq.SchemaField("label","INT64")]
job_config=bq.LoadJobConfig(schema=schema, skip_leading_rows=1, source_format=bq.SourceFormat.CSV, write_disposition="WRITE_TRUNCATE")
with open("data/training_data.csv","rb") as f:
    job=client.load_table_from_file(f, table_id, job_config=job_config)
job.result()
t=client.get_table(table_id)
print("Loaded", t.num_rows, "rows into", table_id)
EOF
mkdir -p .tmp && python .tmp_load.py

python -c '
import os, google.cloud.bigquery as bq
project=os.environ["GCP_PROJECT"]; ds=os.environ["GCP_BQ_DATASET"]
client=bq.Client(project=project)
t=f"{project}.{ds}.training_data"
feats=["f1","f2","f3","f4","f5","f6"]
sel=", ".join(["CORR("+f+", label) AS c_"+f for f in feats])
q="SELECT "+sel+" FROM `"+t+"`"
row=list(client.query(q).result())[0]
print("Pearson corr with label:")
for f in feats:
    print("  "+f+": "+format(row["c_"+f],".4f"))
# class-conditional separation: mean by label and pooled std -> effect size
print()
print("Class-conditional means (label=0 vs 1) and separation score:")
parts=[]
for f in feats:
    parts.append("AVG(IF(label=0,"+f+",NULL)) AS m0_"+f)
    parts.append("AVG(IF(label=1,"+f+",NULL)) AS m1_"+f)
    parts.append("STDDEV(IF(label=0,"+f+",NULL)) AS s0_"+f)
    parts.append("STDDEV(IF(label=1,"+f+",NULL)) AS s1_"+f)
q2="SELECT "+", ".join(parts)+" FROM `"+t+"`"
r=list(client.query(q2).result())[0]
for f in feats:
    m0=r["m0_"+f]; m1=r["m1_"+f]; s0=r["s0_"+f]; s1=r["s1_"+f]
    pooled=((s0**2+s1**2)/2)**0.5
    d=abs(m1-m0)/pooled if pooled else float("inf")
    print("  "+f+": mean0="+format(m0,".3f")+" mean1="+format(m1,".3f")+" cohen_d="+format(d,".3f"))
'
tool_input.description: Correlation and class-conditional separation in BigQuery
